players.bio: Abdülkadir Ömür (born 25 June 1999) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Premier League club Hull City and the Turkey national team.
Charles Roger Hughes (born 16 October 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Hull City.
Christos Mouzakitis (Greek: Χρήστος Μουζακίτης; born 25 December 2006) is a Greek professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Hull City and the Greece national team.
Darko Boateng Gyabi (born 18 February 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Premier League club Hull City.
Dillon Phillips (born 11 June 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Hull City.
Eliot Matazo (born 15 February 2002) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Hull City.
Hidemasa Morita (守田 英正, Morita Hidemasa; born 10 May 1995) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Hull City and the Japan national team.

Jack Butland (born 10 March 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Hull City. Butland began his career with Birmingham City, and made his debut in the Football League in September 2011 while on loan to League Two club Cheltenham Town.
Jens Hjertø-Dahl (born 31 October 2005) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Hull City.
Joseph Paul Gelhardt (born 4 May 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EPL club Hull City.

John Patrick Egan (born 20 October 1992) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Hull City and the Republic of Ireland national team. Beginning his career at Sunderland, he had loan spells with Crystal Palace, Sheffield United, Bradford City and Southend United, but was released by the Wearside club without making an appearance for the first team.

Kieran O'Neill Dowell (born 10 October 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Hull City. Dowell previously played for Everton having graduated from their youth academy in 2014, from where he had loan spells with Nottingham Forest, Sheffield United, Derby County and Wigan Athletic.
Konstantinos Tzolakis (Greek: Κωνσταντίνος Τζολάκης; born 8 November 2002) is a Greek professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Hull City and the Greece national team.
Lewie Jacob Coyle (born 15 October 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right back and captains Premier League club Hull City.
Lucas Gourna-Douath (born 5 August 2003) is a French professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Hull City.
Matt Davidson Rider Crooks (born 20 January 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Hull City.

Matthew Robert Targett (born 18 September 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Premier League club Hull City. Targett came through the Southampton academy and was named their young player of the season in 2015, having broken into their Premier League squad during that campaign.

Mohamed El Bachir Belloumi (Arabic: محمد البشير بلومي; born 1 June 2002), also known as Bachir Belloumi, is an Algerian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Premier League club Hull City and the Algeria national team. He is the son of Algerian former footballer Lakhdar Belloumi.

Mohamed-Ali Cho is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward for Premier League club Hull City. Born in France and raised in England, Cho previously represented England as a youth international before switching his allegiance to France.
Nobel Mendy (born 16 August 2004) is a French-Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Premier League club Hull City and the Senegal national team.

Oliver Robert McBurnie (born 4 June 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Hull City and the Scotland national football team. After playing youth football for Leeds United, McBurnie began his career with Bradford City, spending two loan spells at Chester.
Óscar Steven Zambrano Preciado (born 20 April 2004) is an Ecuadorian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Hull City.

Patrick James Coleman McNair (born 27 April 1995) is a Northern Irish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or right-back for Premier League club Hull City and the Northern Ireland national team. McNair signed for Manchester United in 2011 and made his professional debut for them in the Premier League in September 2014.
Regan Newman Slater (born 11 September 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Hull City.
Ryan John Giles (born 26 January 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Premier League club Hull City.

Oluwasemilogo Adesewo Ibidapo "Semi" Ajayi (born 9 November 1993) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Hull City. Born in England, he plays for the Nigeria national team.

Sergej Jakirović (23 December 1976) is a professional football manager and former player who is the current manager of Premier League club Hull City. He played for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.

Benjamin Sorba William Thomas (born 25 January 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Premier League club Hull City and the Wales national team. After leaving the West Ham United Academy at 16, Thomas played for National League side Boreham Wood until he was signed by Championship side Huddersfield Town in January 2021.

Timothy Emeka Iroegbunam (pronounced , irr-ə-BOO-nəm; born 30 June 2003) is an English footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Hull City. Iroegbunam is a product of the West Bromwich Albion and Aston Villa academies.
